privacy.heading: Privacy Policy.
privacy.leadText: Last updated: November 2026. Your privacy and trust are paramount to Digital Custard.

sections.title: 1. Introduction.
sections.content: Digital Custard ("we", "our", or "us") operates digital marketing, AI, and IT consultation services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit our website or engage with our services.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect.
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us through contact forms, emails, phone inquiries, and service consultations. This may include your name, email address, phone number, company name, and project specifications.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use the collected information solely to respond to your inquiries, deliver our digital marketing and IT solutions, send requested project updates, and enhance your website experience. We do not sell or lease your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Data Security.
sections.content: We implement industry-standard technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

sections.title: 5. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out to us at info@digitalcustard.in.
